newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Jan 3.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:

- An American mediator failed to conclude a long-delayed agreement on a partial Israeli pullback in Hebron as Palestinians dug in on their insistence for deadlines and guarantees for the further withdrawal of Israeli forces in the West Bank.
- Newt Gingrich's re-election as Speaker of the House appeared threatened, at least for the moment, as the number of Republicans unwilling to commit themselves to him reached 27.
- In reading and math achievement, New York City schools lag behind those elsewhere in the state, and the gap widens as students get older.
- Federal aviation officials have failed to meet their commitment to increase the number of air traffic controllers in the New York region.
- Once regarded as an oasis of civility and democracy among former Soviet republics, Armenia has drifted toward dictatorship.

- Billionaire Sir James Goldsmith is back in Britain with his own new political party, to which he has pledged more than $30 million, for the purpose of halting Britain's integration into the European Community.
